summary: Admit bounded Russian Post formed-order PDF generation through the existing document reader.

impacts.evidence: The existing tenant-scoped Russian Post account and capability path remain the source of the document request.
The provider PDF is reduced to an opaque digest reference before leaving host transport.
The existing label endpoint is reused and formed_order_pdf is an additive explicit format.
No event envelope, event type or event payload changes.
The existing logistics.label.read capability and LabelRequest interface remain unchanged.
No database columns, mappings or durable provider payloads are added.
The order ID, response media type and PDF signature are bounded and validated before artifact publication.
The existing label permission and active account gates continue to protect the read operation.
Existing logistics label lineage records the opaque artifact reference without document contents.
Repeated reads are deterministic for the same validated order; ambiguous responses never fabricate a document.
The transport calls only the fixed official Russian Post host under the existing host-mediated egress boundary.
Existing logistics timeout, rate and error normalization covers the additional document request.
Removing the explicit format admission closes formed-order reads without migration.
Deterministic adapter and host tests verify path, date, print type, auth, PDF validation and opaque artifact prefix.
